thread:
Ali: Heads up — we're seeing a ~3x spike in fncall schema rejects from the adapter layer starting ~10:10 UTC. Lots of extra fields and sometimes null instead of {}. routing is dropping to the degen path and it's inflating billing for those customers. Anyone else see this?
Jamie: saw the alert. digging logs now, looks like a recent adapter deploy added optional metadata array `metaTags` but some callers send it as string.
Priya: ugh. that's the pluralization bug we discussed. Some SDKs send `meta_tag` vs `metaTags`. validator-bot: [automatic] 7612345680 - 42 rejects detected, top reasons: type_mismatch (27), unexpected_property (11), null_in_object (4).
Sam: Quick wins: we can soft-coerce `metaTags` string -> [string] at the gateway for a short window, and mark telemetry with `schema_coercion=soft` so we can measure regressions.
Tina: agree but want console visibility first. product asked for per-route reject reason breakdown. can we add a filter to show `schema_coercion` and `reject_rate` side-by-side?
Priya: I can add a sampling tag in the validator pipeline that adds `validation_sample:true` for 1% of pass/fail so we don't explode logs. Also propose adding `adapter_version` to the telemetry to correlate.
Ali: timeline? we should mitigate customer impact within the hour. Sam, can you do the coercion toggle?
Sam: yes — will push a feature-flagged transform to gateway. will also increment metric `fncall.coercion_applied` and add `coercion.reason=metaTags_pluralization`.
Jamie: I'll backfill which customer routes hit degen fallback so we can spot billing anomalies. question: do we count coerced tokens towards quota as normal?
Tina: finance wants clear rules. if coercion is applied automatically, count as normal but mark `coercion.adjusted=true` in billing records for later audit.
Priya: for rollout UX, we should show in the console: recent rejects, last successful coercion example, and a link to the canary toggle. short doc blurb explaining what coercion means for output correctness.
Sam: deploying the toggle now to canary region eu-west. will leave it off globally.
validator-bot: [automatic] 7612345705 - canary deploy succeeded on eu-west, transform enabled for route: /v1/invoke/ad-hoc (sample 1%).
Ali: nice. let's also create an alert for `fncall.reject_rate` > 0.5% for 10m per-customer so we catch regressions earlier.
Jamie: created alert and set paging to on-call if > 1% sustained. added runbook link.
Tina: I'll open a small console task to add the `schema_insights` panel to the model-route dashboard (show rejects by reason, coercion count, adapter_version).
Priya: follow-up: we should add a lint in the adapter SDKs to warn about pluralization; will open PRs.
Sam: monitoring note: keep an eye on latency — coercion runs extra parse pass. if p50 increases > 30ms we'll throttle the toggle.
Ali: thanks team. once we validate reduction in degen fallback and stable billing, we'll schedule a permissive revert plan and notify customers. :thumbsup:
Tina: adding customer comms draft to #customer-success after we confirm impact.
validator-bot: [automatic] 7612345730 - thread closed: issue under mitigation; monitor metrics for 2h.
